purpose: Separately-labelled convergence extension of the H8 start-aligned control: a fresh run with a 100k-step cosine schedule (not a resume of the 20k run, whose LR schedule had completed). Tests whether frame structure reaches its occlusion floor and whether motion calibration ever recovers with more optimization.

frozen_model.backbone: full spatiotemporal DiT with signed local temporal and spatial 3D RoPE
frozen_model.teacher_forcing: clean ground-truth history during training; generated history during rollout

selection_evidence.horizon_pilot: H8 gave the best motion/topology balance among H4, H8, and H40 at 2,000 steps
selection_evidence.decoded_auxiliary: rejected at n=64 because selective LIE/CPE gains did not offset worse TVR, occupancy, prompt sensitivity, motion calibration, and training cost

validation.final_evaluation: 64 prompt-disjoint held-out videos with fixed prompt/noise seeds, 10 Euler steps per block, topology and temporal metrics with bootstrap CIs
validation.claim_limit: The final run is one training seed and supports a released reference baseline, not an architecture ranking.
